byref_boundary_policy.primary_axis: behavior owner before byref promotion/copy/dispose/forwarding row, private helper snapshot, proof-only helper row, stack-only byref row, generated report, or runnable proof label
byref_boundary_policy.support_authority: byref forwarding support requires lowering and runtime owner assignment over canonical fixtures and probes
byref_boundary_policy.retired_surface_rule: proof-only promotion helper rows, stack-only byref success, source-only sidecar ownership, private-snapshot-only rows, fallback byref helper rows, shim byref rows, old-mode byref rows, and evidence-log proof rows are provenance, canonical rejection, strict-error, or absent-support evidence

implementation_invariants.summary: Promotion must preserve exactly one copy-helper transition into the runtime-owned block state for the canonical byref probe.
Dispose is deferred until final release and invoke-after-release must fail closed.
The disposed payload and invoke results must reflect the promoted storage rather than post-promotion stack mutation.
